name: CORE Team
description: Sets summit strategy, coordinates workstreams, resolves cross-team decisions, and maintains the shared event timeline.

name: Guest Experience & Registration
description: Creates a welcoming, accessible arrival-to-departure experience and coordinates registration support with Luma.

name: Branding, Signage & Media
description: Maintains a consistent summit identity across print, digital, venue signage, photography, and published media.

name: Public Relations & Protocols
description: Coordinates official messaging, dignitary protocols, press engagement, social amplification, and sensitive communications.

name: Programming & Stage Management
description: Builds the technical program, prepares speakers, protects session quality, and keeps every stage on schedule.

name: Technical Production
description: Owns the end-to-end technical delivery plan for keynotes, presentations, demonstrations, labs, and recording.

name: AV & IT
description: Delivers reliable presentation, audio, networking, streaming, and participant connectivity across the venue.

name: Venue Operations & Logistics
description: Coordinates rooms, safety, furniture, catering, deliveries, setup, teardown, and operational vendors.

name: Sponsorship & Partner Management
description: Aligns sponsor benefits, partner participation, booth needs, commitments, acknowledgements, and post-event follow-up.

name: Academic Engagement & Student Outreach
description: Connects universities, faculty, student chapters, and emerging researchers through posters, volunteers, and learning opportunities.
